result.reason: The addition is targeted and includes workmanlike performance, Site conformance, legal compliance, no malicious code, and the required remedy types. However, it does not provide the required 90-day service-warranty period. In addition, the Site warranty runs from the Effective Date rather than delivery or acceptance, so some or all of the 12-month period could expire before the Site is delivered. The margin comment does not cure these operative-language deficiencies.
